EvaluateCertificateQuality.title: Certificate Photo Quality Review
EvaluateCertificateQuality.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the EvaluateCertificateQuality API for certificate photo quality review.
EvaluateCertificateQuality.description:
## Feature Description  
The certificate photo quality review feature can detect whether a captured certificate photo has quality issues and identify the specific types of quality issues present.

> - You can obtain online assistance from human support by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For questions regarding API integration, API usage, or general inquiries about Visual AI capabilities of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  

- **Online Authentication**: During online authentication, users are often required to submit photos of certificates such as identity cards, business licenses, passports, or checks. However, the quality of these photos varies significantly—some fail to meet clarity requirements due to poor shooting conditions or watermarks. The certificate photo quality review feature can automatically detect quality issues in certificate images, reducing the need for manual review.  
- **Registration and Enrollment**: During offline registration processes, electronic photos of certificates must be taken. However, shooting conditions vary, and some photos suffer from quality problems. By using the certificate photo quality review feature, problematic photos can be filtered out to prevent operational failures or errors during subsequent usage or recognition steps.

## Key Advantages  

- **Comprehensive Inspection**: Performs a thorough check on all photo quality factors that may affect authentication validity. Inspection items include: whether the document matches the expected certificate type, whether a front-facing photo is missing, whether the image is a photocopy, whether the certificate image is complete, whether official seals are missing, whether the source is an electronic document, presence of glare, presence of watermark coverage, and text definition. These checks collectively assess whether the photo meets authentication requirements.  
- **Real-World Business Experience**: This algorithm is refined through extensive real-world application within Alibaba Group and incorporates practical insights into various quality issues that commonly impact registration and review processes, thereby enabling greater automation for your business.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete account registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure that you have activated the [Image Recognition service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imagerecog). If not, activate it immediately by visiting [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imagerecog_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For detailed instructions, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online Debugging (Optional)**: You can debug this feature using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imagerecog/2019-09-30/EvaluateCertificateQuality?lang=JAVA) to view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Development Integration Steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "image recognition" (imagerecog).  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this feature, see [Sample Code for Certificate Photo Quality Review](~~601120~~).  

7. **Direct Client-Side Invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this feature include:  
   - [Direct Invocation from Web Frontend](~~467779~~)

- **URLs**: Must not contain Chinese characters.

TaggingAdImage.title: Ad Material Analysis
TaggingAdImage.description:
## Feature Description  
The Ad Material Analysis feature can tag characters (celebrities, ordinary people, CG characters), scenes, and other elements in ad material images. It supports thousands of content tags with broad coverage.

> - You can obtain online assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Visual Intelligence capabilities of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios

- **Ad Analysis**: Analyze data on Internet advertising content and campaign performance to provide reference insights for ad placement and analysis.  
- **Precise Targeting**: Achieve accurate ad delivery by leveraging material tags and user personas.  
- **Material Retrieval**: Quickly search and locate materials of specific types.

## Key Advantages

- **Strong Analytical Capability**: Accurately tags complex scenes containing celebrities, ordinary individuals, CG characters, and more after analysis and processing.  
- **Precise Tagging**: Returns object- and character-related tags simultaneously and accurately marks the location of each tag.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure that you have activated the [Image Recognition service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imagerecog). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imagerecog_public_cn#/open).  
3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug this capability using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imagerecog/2019-09-30/TaggingAdImage?lang=JAVA) to view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "Image Recognition" (`imagerecog`).  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  
6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages for this feature, see [Ad Material Analysis Sample Code](~~601117~~). For sample code to query asynchronous task results, see [Query Asynchronous Task Result Sample Code](~~607974~~).  
7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods for this feature include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Restrictions

- **Image formats**: JPEG, JPG, PNG, BMP.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 3 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Greater than 5×5 pixels.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.

## Billing Information  
For details about the metering method and pricing of Ad Material Analysis, see [Billing Introduction](~~202481~~).

> The debugging API below is a paid API.

## Invocation Steps  
This feature is asynchronous and requires two-step invocation:  
1. Call the `TaggingAdImage` API to submit a job. Upon successful request, you will receive a job ID.  
2. Call the [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~) API to query the result using the job ID. This returns the task execution status and result. If the task is still being processed, wait a short while before querying again. We recommend not resubmitting the same task until its previous execution has completed.
TaggingAdImage.responseParamsDescription:
## Parameter Guide for TagInfo Fields

| Field                | Type   | Required | Example Value               | Description                                                                                                               |
| -------------------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Cloth_category       | string | Yes      | modern                      | When the field is HumanInfo, this field indicates the detected clothing label of the person. For specific categories, see the "Category Tag Values" figure below. If the field is not HumanInfo, this field can be ignored. |
| Cloth_category_score | float  | Yes      | 0.8                         | When the field is HumanInfo, this field indicates the confidence level of the clothing label. The value range is [0, 1.0]. If the field is not HumanInfo, this field can be ignored. |
| Bbox                 | list   | Yes      | [77,280,431,569]            | Indicates the relative time position where the element appears in the video.                                              |
| Score                | float  | Yes      | 0.9                         | Confidence level of the tag. The value range is [0, 1.0].                                                                |
| Category             | string | Yes      | human-real-celebrity-明星姓名 | Tag name. For specific categories, see the "Category Tag Values" figure below.                                            |

## Category Tag Values
![Category Tag Values](https://viapi-oss.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/doc/imagerecog/Image%201.png)

## Query Result
This API is asynchronous and does not return the actual result immediately. You must use the returned RequestId to invoke the GetAsyncJobResult API to retrieve the actual result. For more information, see [GetAsyncJobResult](~~607824~~).

Alibaba Cloud Vision AI recommends using a software development kit (SDK) to call the Ad Material Analysis capability under the image recognition category. Multiple programming languages are supported. When making a call, select the SDK package for the image recognition (imagerecog) AI category. The file parameter supports both local files and arbitrary URLs when using the SDK. For details, see [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
